Wang Yuxuan’s Reflective Interview

Wang Yuxuan, the 2021 Golden Horse Award winner for Best Supporting Actress, discusses how her own teenage rebellion shaped her portrayal of Lin Jialin in "Goddamned Asura." She recounts skipping over 100 classes in high school, nearly facing expulsion, and the pivotal gap years that led her to discover a passion for acting. Under the guidance of her drama teacher Li Mingzhe and director Lou Yi-an, Wang immersed herself in Taipei’s Wanhua District to capture the authentic voice of her character, even contributing to the film’s dialogue.
